subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some bags are books.

2. All pen are books

**.Conclusions:**

1. All bags are pens.

2. All bags are books

3. No pen is a book

4. No pens are bag.
solution:
The possible Venn diagram is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a76ca203ddce518b79eb16a2308f67d03dfc02f1dacff855c0dca46a08e5744b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7a727e45d0aae944b68fba56d3419bbe3434efb77f5381bbe5024cf868da142.png] 

Conclusion1. All bags are pens [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] False( as there is no definite relation between bags and pens as shown above in venn diagram)

Conclusion2. All bags are books [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] False ( because some bags are books )

Conclusion 3. No pen is a book [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] False ( there is a definite relation between pen and book)

Conclusion4. No pens are bag [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] True (because all pens are books)

Only conclusion 4 logically follows from the statement

Hence, **Option 1)** is the correct answer.
